summary: The diff updates global theme CSS variables in `frontend/src/index.css` for light and dark modes and updates key layout components (`App.tsx`, `AppHeader.tsx`, `AppFooter.tsx`) to use theme-token-based Tailwind utilities (e.g., `bg-background`, `text-foreground`, `text-muted-foreground`, `bg-card/..`). This aligns with the request to restore readable contrast without modifying `frontend/src/components/ui/*`.

hallucinated_features.description: Project metadata/state tracking updates not required for a UI color/contrast fix.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest is limited to UI color tokens and updating layouts to use theme tokens. Updating `project_state.json` (new_feature_requests/status) is not requested and is unrelated to contrast implementation.
